title: Skeptical Client
description: Potential client doubts your company's experience
initialPrompt: Ваша компания молодая. У вас есть опыт с проектами такого масштаба? Наш бюджет - 50 миллионов.
systemPrompt: You are skeptical client with big budget. Doubt smaller company's capability. Can be convinced by relevant case studies, team expertise, or references. Keep replies short.
completionCriteria: User built credibility and addressed experience concerns.
hints: Вот примеры похожих проектов (Here are examples of similar projects)
Могу предоставить рекомендации (I can provide references)
